title: THE MOVING MORNING — Tone Bloom Daily 003
dek: A seventy-two-second sound garden, followed by Airy Garden Mix.
body:
THE MOVING MORNING is Tone Bloom Daily 003: a finite seventy-two-second passage through eight wind shrines and four flower interludes. The movement uses twelve original Web Audio cues, opening trills, tuned metallic voices, soft air, and short silences to make a small threshold for the day.

The companion playlist, AIRY GARDEN MIX, carries the feeling outward for thirty tracks and roughly ninety minutes. It moves through strings, garden electronics, soft piano, and wind-lit instrumental motion. The playlist is public on Spotify and now carries original Tone Bloom artwork: a black hanging bell, cream streamers, coral and yellow flowers, and a cobalt vase under a clear blue sky.

The Daily requires no login, creates no streak, and asks for no catch-up. Audio begins only after a visitor presses the opening control. Tone Bloom synthesizes its interactive sounds in the browser; the Spotify companion uses Spotify's official playback surface.
